---
id: identity-account-delete
title: "Delete the signed-in account after a recent login"
description: "Requires a login within the last hour and the account's own email address, compared after normalization. The request locks the account at once: from its commit the cookie reads as a guest and login answers wrong_password. A worker job then deletes the account's data. Administrators and banned accounts are refused."

Requires a login within the last hour and the account's own email address, compared after normalization. The request locks the account at once: from its commit the cookie reads as a guest and login answers wrong_password. A worker job then deletes the account's data. Administrators and banned accounts are refused.
